Author: mastajooh
Name: Anywear Numbra
Punchline: Changes your outfit (equipment only) from your Glamourer designs when you change zones or enter duties.
Description: Applies the equipment portion of your saved Glamourer designs to your own character after zone changes, teleports and duty entry. Hair, face, skin, body, identity and visual effects are never changed. Weapons, facewear and hat/visor visibility are opt-in. Requires Glamourer; Penumbra is optional.
